title: Möbius Inversion and Inclusion-Exclusion: Boolean Lattice Connection
description: Formalizes Gian-Carlo Rota's (1964) insight that the Inclusion-Exclusion Principle is Möbius inversion on the Boolean lattice. Defines the Möbius function on Finset subsets, proves alternating binomial sum identities, zeta/Möbius transform properties, and the classical PIE as a special case. 2 axioms. 24 theorems.

overview.historicalContext: Rota (1964) unified combinatorial identities as Möbius inversions on posets: Boolean lattice → PIE, divisor lattice → number-theoretic Möbius function.

overview.proofStrategy: Define posetZeta and Möbius function; prove alternating binomial identity; express PIE formula via Möbius function.
